name: etl_failure
title: ETL fact load failure (ORA-12541)
description: etl_load_facts fails today after 5 retries with ORA-12541. Same error occurred 3 days ago (May 25) and was resolved by restarting the Oracle listener.
expected_demo_path: From sidebar, click status on etl_load_facts → agent reports FAILURE with return code 137 and the ORA-12541 error.
Ask: 'have we seen this before?' → agent calls find_similar_incidents, surfaces the May 25 INC-2026-05-25-001 with its full resolution.
Ask: 'how do we fix it?' → agent recommends restarting the Oracle listener on db-warehouse-prod-01.internal, citing the past resolution steps.
Ask: 'what's blocked downstream?' → agent calls get_dependencies; explains validate_daily can't run and the morning reporting box has been started manually on stale data.
